title: [29x]-Bug 658773: Mileage: starting/ending point addresses over 50 characters fail to save on report lines (BC Text[50] limit not enforced)
summary: Mileage starting and ending point addresses longer than 50 characters now save correctly on expense and expense report lines.
key_points: Extended address field length to accommodate addresses exceeding 50 character BC Text limit
Fixed for Expense, Expense Report Line, and Posted Expense Report Line tables
Addresses now properly persist without truncation or save failures
